September 16, 2026 Prof. Kahng and Prof. Vidya Chhabria of Arizona State University presented a webinar today, "Siemens EDA and the IEEE Council on EDA: Enabling and Accelerating the Academic EDA Research Ecosystem". Their slides are HERE (.pptx with speaker notes, plus .pdf ). Huge thanks to Mathilde Karsenti for the kind invitation, and to many Siemens EDA folks for the collaborations on IEEE CEDA DATC's RDF-2025 and RDF-2026 (and more) over these past two years! September 14, 2026 A couple of fragments from a brief interview about OpenAI's Jalapeno announcement at HotChips made it into Matthew Smith's IEEE Spectrum article . Contact Prof. Kahng if you have feedback or would like more background on the Q&A with Matthew! July 28, 2026 We are happy to report that the 7th DAC Birds-of-a-Feather meeting on Open-Source EDA , on the theme of "Open-Source EDA, Data and Collaboration", once again had its largest-ever attendance, with great talks from around the world, and from across industry and academia. All the talk slides have now been posted. Many thanks to Yiting Liu of UCSD and Oleg Levitsky of Precision Innovations for all their work to organize the event, and many thanks to the sponsors (especially, CHIPS Alliance and Precision Innovations) as well. Thanks also to many student helpers, and above all to the speakers and audience, for a long and exciting evening! Your interests and suggestions with regard to next year's edition can be given via this form . See you next year in San Jose! July 27, 2026 Prof. Kahng presented the invited special session paper , "Progress and Roadmap Toward an Automated EDA R&D Engineer", today at the 63rd Design Automation Conference . His slides are HERE (.pptx with speaker notes, plus .pdf ). All credit to Amur Ghose, Bodhi Pramanik and other coauthors for this work and vision! July 26, 2026 Prof. Kahng and Davit Markarian presented "Chipshub Contributions from UCSD" today at the Chipshub Faculty Fellows Train the Trainers Workshop . Their slides are HERE (.pptx with speaker notes, plus .pdf ). Your feedback and suggestions for improvement -- to the UCSD ECE 260C course in particular -- are welcome! Many thanks to Professor Matt Morrison and the NSF Chipshub for organizing the event! July 21, 2026 Prof. Kahng gave the inaugural talk today, on "Agentic AI for EDA: Observations and Outlook", at Intel's "From Silicon to Systems: The AI Roadmap Series" seminar series. His slides are HERE (.pptx with speaker notes, plus .pdf ). Many thanks to Uday Mallappa for the kind invitation! July 8, 2026 Prof. Kahng gave a talk today at FSiC-2026 in Ljubljana, Slovenia: "Coding agents to accelerate open-source EDA innovation". His slides are HERE (.pptx with speaker notes, plus .pdf ). July 6, 2026 Prof. Kahng gave the opening keynote today at FSiC-2026 in Ljubljana, Slovenia: "(How) Will FSiC Be Remembered?". His slides are HERE (.pptx with speaker notes, plus .pdf ). Many thanks to Luca Alloatti and all the FSiC organizers for their kind invitation! June 23, 2026 Prof. Kahng gave a keynote today at MPSoC-2026 in Victoria, Canada: "Agentic AI for EDA: Observations and Outlook". His slides are HERE (.pptx with speaker notes). Thanks to Professor Marilyn Wolf and the MPSoC organizers for their kind invitation! May 15, 2026 We are happy to note the release of the white paper, " Toward Cognitive Silicon Design: Structural Barriers and an Industry Roadmap for AI-Native Chip Design ," which summarizes findings from the first Cognitive Silicon Design Workshop (CSDW), convened on April 3, 2026, at Meta Sunnyvale Campus. Kudos to Dharmesh Jani of Meta and the entire team of dedicated workshop organizers and presenters! May 13, 2026 Congratulations to Bodhi Pramanik on passing his University Qualifying Examination!!! May 2, 2026 Prof. Kahng gave a talk today at Latch-Up 2026 in Waterloo, Canada: "OpenROAD and the Era of Agents". His slides are HERE (.pptx with speaker notes). Thanks to the FOSSi Foundation and Dr. Tim Edwards for their kind invitation! April 24, 2026 Prof. Kahng was in the panel session, "Understanding Open Source Pathways--A Review of NSF POSE Funded Projects across the UC System" , today at the UC Open Summit . His slides are HERE (.pptx with speaker notes). March 27, 2026 Congratulations to Sayak Kundu on passing his Ph.D. defense!!! March 24, 2026 Prof. Kahng gave a talk today at the SOS 28 Workshop in Santa Barbara: "The OpenROAD Project and Ecosystem" as part of the Open Hardware Technologies session organized by Dr. Jim Ang of Pacific Northwest National Laboratory. His slides are HERE (.pptx with speaker notes, plus .pdf ). February 5, 2026 Professor Kahng posted this "Epilogue" to the June 6, 2022 "For the Record" Google Doc. Thanks as always to all who have engaged in this effort! [ cached .pdf of Google Doc file ] December 22, 2025 UC San Diego Today published a nice article today, "UC San Diego is Strengthening U.S. Semiconductor Innovation and Workforce Development", about several ongoing efforts in our lab. The article is HERE [cached .pdf of the article ]. October 29, 2025 Kudos to Siemens EDA and the IEEE CEDA Design Automation Technical Committee for the collaborative efforts that resulted in the first-ever public reporting of benchmark results for a commercial place-and-route tool (Siemens EDA's Aprisa), with permission of the tool vendor. This breakthrough finally enables EDA researchers to see their field's leading edge in a clear, reproducible and sharable way. Our ICCAD-2025 paper (.pdf) is HERE (please see Section II), and the ICCAD-2025 presentation slides (.pptx) are HERE . Please also see the IEEE CEDA DATC GitHub repository, HERE . October 28, 2025 We are incredibly grateful that our project, "Trustworthy and Secure Cloud-Native Agentic OpenROAD", has been selected for an award as part of the Microsoft/NAIRR Pilot call for grand challenges and deep partnerships . Huge thanks to Microsoft Azure and the NAIRR Pilot program for this fantastic boost to our research! October 20, 2025 Prof. Kahng gave a workshop talk today on "How We Will Make an Automated Digital IC Designer". His slides are HERE (.pptx with speaker notes, plus .pdf ). Please also see ( .pptx , .pdf ) of the accompanying poster presented by Amur Ghose. October 1, 2025 We are happy to note the opening of our GitHub repo for the ISPD26 Contest on Post-Placement Buffering and Sizing. Kudos to Sayak Kundu, Yiting Liu and Davit Markarian, as well as to our co-organizers Seonghyeon Park and Zhiang Wang, for all their efforts. And, many thanks to the NSF Chipshub, NVIDIA, and the ISPD committee for their support. We look forward to an exciting contest! September 22, 2025 Prof. Kahng presented "Open-Source EDA and Agentic AI: Recent Explorations With OpenROAD" at today's IEEE SSCS webinar on "From Words to Circuits: Agentic AI, Foundation Models, and Open EDA Workshop". His slides are HERE (.pptx with speaker notes). Thanks to the organizers for the kind invitation to be part of a great program! August 21, 2025 Congratulations to Yiting Liu and Zhiang Wang on receiving a Best Artifact Award at MLCAD-2025 for their work, "Recursive Learning-Based Virtual Buffering for Analytical Global Placement". The paper will be presented at MLCAD on September 9. August 12, 2025 Congratulations to Amur Ghose, Sayak Kundu and Zhiang Wang on receiving the Best Paper Award at MLCAD-2025 for their work, "ORFS-agent: Tool-Using Agents for Chip Design Optimization". The paper will be presented at MLCAD on September 9. August 12, 2025 We are happy to note the public posting of the HEP-Alliance 's working paper on "Free and Open Chip Design Tools" HERE . Kudos to Arnd Weber, Norbert Herfurth and Steffen Reith on the completion of their long efforts! August 1, 2025 We are happy to share that UCSD will lead the two-year $1.4M NSF POSE: Phase II project on "Growing a Collaborative Ecosystem for Open-Source Chip Design Using OpenROAD" [ award abstract ]. Prof. Kahng serves as project PI, with co-PIs Vidya Chhabria (ASU), Mehdi Saligane (Brown) and Tom Spyrou (Precision Innovations). UCSD is also part of "Chipshub", a four-year $7M NSF Chip Design Hub project on "Open, Accessible and Scalable Infrastructure for Research and Education" [ award abstract ]. Prof. Kahng serves as Chipshub project co-PI. July 4, 2025 Prof. Kahng presented the talk, "The OpenROAD Project: Status and Paths Forward", today at FSiC-2025 , which was held at the IHP foundry in Frankfurt an der Oder. His slides are HERE (.pptx with speaker notes). Thanks to the organizers, hosts, and attendees for inspiring and thought-provoking presentations and discussions! July 2, 2025 We are happy to note the posting of the English version [ cached.pdf ] of the acatech IMPULSE publication, "Open-source Design Tools for Sovereign Chip Development". Kudos to Professors Wolfgang Nebel and Robert Weigel, and the team that produced this report. June 24, 2025 We are happy to report that the 6th DAC Birds-of-a-Feather meeting on Open-Source EDA , on the theme of "Open-Source EDA, Data and Collaboration", had its largest-ever attendance with great talks from around the world, and from across industry and academia. Your interests with regard to next year's edition can be given via this form . Many thanks to the co-organizers, sponsors, student helpers, and above all the speakers and audience for a long and exciting evening! May 7, 2025 Our lab's P. O. Pistilli Scholarship webpage has been updated for the last time. April 16, 2025 Prof. Kahng gave a workshop talk today on "Models for the Physical Universe of Semiconductor IC Design: What's Different (and Difficult)". His slides are HERE (.pptx with speaker notes). March 27, 2025 Congratulations to Sayak Kundu on passing his University Qualifying Examination!!! March 27, 2025 We are happy to announce that updates of our MacroPlacement work are available in the "march_updates" branch of the TILOS MacroPlacement repository, HERE . To run our improved "go-with-the-winners" simulated annealing baseline on our testcases, please follow the steps provided HERE . And, to run the latest Circuit Training ("AlphaChip") on our testcases using our settings, please follow the steps provided HERE . All feedback is welcome. Kudos to Sayak Kundu, Yucheng Wang and Zhiang Wang for all their effort! January 29, 2025 The final report from "Design for America: A Workshop on a National Design Enablement Gateway ("DEG")" has been posted HERE . (A cached copy is HERE .) For this workshop, Professor Kahng had the pleasure of co-chairing SIG #1, "Interoperability of EDA Tools", with Rob Aslett of Si2. October 16, 2024 UC San Diego Today published a nice article today, "Open-source Semiconductor Chip Design Tool Celebrates Success", about The OpenROAD Project. The article is HERE [cached .pdf of the article ]. October 2, 2024 Prof. Kahng has joined the Governing Board of the CHIPS Alliance , a directed fund of The Linux Foundation. August 26, 2024 Congratulations to Bodhisatta Pramanik on passing his ECE Prelim Exam!!! August 20, 2024 Prof. Kahng presented "AI, EDA and Design: Paths to Disruptive Innovation" in the opening keynote at ISOCC-2024. His slides are HERE (.pptx source with speaker notes). June 26, 2024 Prof. Kahng served on the DAC-2024 Research Panel, " Power Your Future: Investments for the Chip Design Workforce and Research " today. The starting question was: "If you had one billion dollars, what would be your top 3 priorities to spend on semiconductor chip design workforce development and how?" Prof. Kahng's panel slides (3-minute limit, due at the start of June) are in this folder and also posted HERE . June 25, 2024 Prof. Kahng presented "AI, EDA and Disruptive Innovation" as today's IEEE CEDA Distinguished Speaker at DAC-2024. His slides are HERE (.pptx source with speaker notes). June 24, 2024 Prof. Kahng presented "Four Freedoms of Democratizing Chip Design" at today's "Democratizing Chip Design" special session in the DAC-2024 Industry Track. His slides are HERE (.pptx source with speaker notes). Many thanks to Sashi Oblisetty for organizing this session and inviting this talk! June 21, 2024 Prof. Kahng presented the keynote talk "OpenROAD and the OpenROAD Initiative: Foundations for Open Innovation" at the 2024 Free Silicon Conference in Paris. His slides are HERE (.pptx source with speaker notes). June 7, 2024 Prof. Kahng presented the keynote talk "Accelerating Design Innovation" at the ETH Future Computing Summer School in Zurich. His slides are HERE (.pptx source with speaker notes). June 6, 2024 Prof. Kahng presented the opening keynote of the Chipdesign Germany kick-off event in Hannover: "Open-Source EDA and Innovation Leadership". His slides are HERE (.pptx source with speaker notes). June 1, 2024 Prof. Kahng will be giving several talks this month. June 6: at the Chipdesign Germany kick-off event in Hannover: the keynote talk "Open-Source EDA and Innovation Leadership" June 7: at the ETH Future Computing Summer School in Zurich: the keynote talk "Accelerating Design Innovation" June 21: at the 2024 Free Silicon Conference in Paris: the keynote talk "OpenROAD and the OpenROAD Initiative: Foundations for Open Innovation" June 25: at DAC 2024 in San Francisco: the IEEE CEDA Distinguished Lecture , "AI for EDA and Disruptive Innovation". (Also, this panel on chip design workforce development, and this industry track session on democratizing chip design.) And, please mark calendars to join with friends and colleagues at the 5th Open-Source EDA Birds-of-a-Feather meeting at DAC, 6:30pm June 25 at Moscone West, Room 3001. (The official title: "Open-Source EDA, Data and Collaboration Summit".) There will be delicious refreshments this year, thanks to CHIPS Alliance! May 28, 2024 Congratulations to Dooseok Yoon on passing his ECE Prelim Exam!!! March 18, 2024 Congratulations to Zhiang Wang on filing his Ph.D. thesis!!! March 13, 2024 Prof. Kahng presented an overview of his invited paper "Solvers, Engines, Tools and Flows: The Next Wave for AI/ML in Physical Design" today at ISPD-2024. (Links: paper , PowerPoint with speaker notes, video .) He also participated in today's "EDA Challenges at Advanced Technology Nodes" panel session ( position statement .pptx with speaker notes). February 28, 2024 Congratulations to Mingyu Woo on filing his Ph.D. thesis!!! February 20, 2024 Congratulations to Zhiang Wang on passing his Ph.D. defense!!! Congratulations to Mingyu Woo on passing his Ph.D. defense!!! January 24, 2024 Prof. Kahng gave the evening keynote at ASP-DAC 2024 today, on "AI/ML and EDA: Current Status and Perspectives on the Future". His slides are HERE (.pptx source with speaker notes). Many thanks to Professors Kyu-Myung Choi and Taewhan Kim for the kind invitation to give the talk! January 17, 2024 Prof. Kahng gave the opening keynote today for a 6-day workshop on "OpenROAD for Low-Cost ASIC Design and Rapid Innovation" at IIT Guwahati. The title of Prof. Kahng's talk was "OpenROAD: A Foundation for IC Design Innovation and Workforce Development". His slides are HERE (.pptx source with speaker notes), and a video of his keynote is HERE (.mp4). Many thanks to Professor Gaurav Trivedi of IITG and others for organizing this wonderful event! December 12, 2023 Congratulations to Zhiang Wang on passing his University Qualifying Examination!!! December 5, 2023 Prof. Kahng presented a talk, "OpenROAD: A Platform for Innovation and Workforce Development", at the U.S.-Japan Collaborative Workshop: Accelerating IC Design [Phase 1] . His slides are HERE (.pptx source with speaker notes). November 11, 2023 Prof. Kahng presented a keynote talk, "The OpenROAD Project: Status and Directions", at today's 8th ADG OpenPower Workshop, "Chip Design to AI Solutions". His slides are HERE (.pptx source with speaker notes). November 3, 2023 Prof. Kahng served on the "Perspectives from the Engineering Community" panel at today's IEEE-USA's Designing Chips with CHIPS: West Coast Pre-Silicon Summit . Slides for his opening position statement are HERE (.pptx source with speaker notes). Note that the last slide has a QR code that links to additional background thoughts HERE . October 30, 2023 Prof. Kahng had the privilege of moderating the ICCAD-2023 panel on "LLM-Aided Design" today, with panelists Anna Goldie, Ruchir Puri, Ramesh Karri, Bei Yu and Haoxing (Mark) Ren. PDF of the compiled position statement slides is HERE . PPTX source for Prof. Kahng's introduction, plus the slide with Prof. Bei Yu's demo video embedded, is HERE . September 15, 2023 Prof. Kahng gave the opening keynote talk, "OpenROAD: The Journey So Far, and the Roadmap", at the 2023 ORconf in Munich. His slides are HERE (.pptx source with speaker notes). August 24, 2023 Prof. Kahng gave a talk at the DARPA MTO ERI 2.0 Summit's workshop on "A New Approach to Microelectronics Workforce Development for Government" ( Heilmeier question #3). His slides are HERE (.pptx source with speaker notes). July 12, 2023 Prof. Kahng gave one of the DAC-2023's new "Lightning Talks" today at the "Everything, EveryPLACE, All At Once!" session. His slides are HERE (.pptx source with speaker notes) and his 2-page writeup is HERE . July 11, 2023 Prof. Kahng participated in the "Why is Curvy Design an Opportunity Now?" research panel at the 60th Design Automation Conference.
